title: verbena subincana
intro: Verbena subincana, commonly known as the "small-leaved verbena" or "small-leaf verbena", is a flowering plant species native to South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Verbena subincana, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and antihistamine effects. The plant's leaves, flowers, and roots have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause.
